name: Apollon ImGui
author: Apollon / ZEFF · reborn
description: Apollon for MC Bedrock 1.26.66.1 (arm64-v8a). Levi Mod Menu build, revised. Menu API is now resolved at RUNTIME (dlsym) so a launcher with a different symbol set can no longer prevent the mod from loading. Modules register during the 'load' lifecycle phase, which is the only phase the launcher wraps in its owning-mod scope (registering later was being silently rejected), and mod_id is left empty so it matches the launcher's install-directory id instead of a hardcoded one.
